'''''IM-873X''''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Star Galleon-class frigate|Star Galleon]] used as a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]]. Over a period of six [[Standard year/Legends|years]] leading to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the ship made regular trips to the [[Corva sector/Legends|Corva sector]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], a delay of eight days caused [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] to take notice. Extrapolating from its fuel capacity, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] found a limited list of where it could have stopped, and it was estimated that its delay was caused to a trip to the [[Stylar Nebula/Legends|Stylar Nebula]], where it had been suspected the Empire was conducting secret military research. The data, coupled with a hacked transmission mentioning [[Project Shell-cracker]], caused the Intelligence to launch a [[Operation: Shell Game|mission]] to the site.

==Behind the scenes==
''IM-873X'' was mentioned in "[[Operation: Shell Game (adventure)|Operation: Shell Game]]," the adventure in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Beta|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Beta]].
